text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhh!! HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can do this...! I know I can...! I have 
to make my move with even more 
determination...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Faster! Fast enough to outrun the wind!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhh!! HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah.... Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just her time. Her positioning 
and corner lines have definitely improved, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: With this, I'll definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Opera O must have gotten even 
stronger over the summer. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Our growth will outshine theirs. We can 
definitely win this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Narita Top Road, who is never 
reckless, to declare it so firmly, she 
must feel quite confident about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I felt as if I could see our victory this 
autumn. Yes..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Barring any "major surprises."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Ayabe-san... That person running 
over there is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O... What was that running...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing like spring at all... And 
the one running alongside is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Simply splendid, Doto!? What on 
earth has gotten into you and your 
running?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to run like that, then I 
have no choice but to stage a revolution 
of my own!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Who on earth are you...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Because I don't want... to 
leave Opera O-san all alone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Both Top Road-san and Ayabe-san are so 
strong, they're scary... That's why...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To keep Opera O-san from losing, I have 
to...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're saying you awakened for 
my sake. However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...No, never mind. No need to tell them 
yet. More importantly, right now—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heading towards the fall! Let us draw a 
more vivid spiral together, Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And let us teach the hot-headed 
Angelottis that a monarchy is not so 
easily overthrown!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm sorry... Saying I was 
guaranteed to win was far too reckless of 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not sure... No, in fact, it 
might be dangerous. We were focusing so 
much on Opera O-chan, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That bottomless power of Doto-chan's... 
And if being stimulated by that causes 
Opera O-chan to grow even further...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Doto certainly isn't the type to 
stand out, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I knew she wasn't just some follower. The 
determination she keeps inside her is 
simply far too strong."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this autumn is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and Admire Vega. TM Opera 
O and Meisho Doto. Their relationships are 
completely equal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whichever of them can inspire, stimulate, 
and elevate the other will be the one 
crowned victorious this autumn."
